articles.title: How to pay an invoice
articles.body: Open Billing, choose the invoice and select Pay now. You can pay by card or UPI. If your organization pays by bank transfer, the invoice shows the bank details and the due date. A receipt is emailed once the payment is confirmed.

articles.title: Download receipts and invoices
articles.body: Every paid invoice has a receipt. Go to Billing, open the invoice and select Download PDF. Receipts include the invoice number, the amount paid and the payment method.

articles.title: Set up single sign-on with SAML
articles.body: Organization admins can connect their identity provider. Add a SAML provider in Sign-in and security, upload the metadata and test the connection. After single sign-on is enabled, members sign in with their company account.

articles.title: Reset two-factor authentication
articles.body: If you lost your phone, use a recovery code to sign in. An organization admin can also reset MFA for a member, who then enrols again at the next sign-in.

articles.title: Add members to your organization
articles.body: Organization admins add people from the Members page. Each active member uses one seat. Suspended members free their seat until they are reactivated.

articles.title: Change the number of seats
articles.body: Open Subscriptions, choose the organization subscription and change the quantity. You cannot go below the number of seats already in use.

articles.title: Automatic renewal and reminders
articles.body: Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each term. Reminder emails are sent before the renewal date at the time and time zone you choose in Preferences.

articles.title: Cancel a subscription
articles.body: You can cancel a subscription from My subscriptions. Cancellation is final: the product stops working at once and the subscription cannot be renewed later.

articles.title: Create an API key
articles.body: Go to Account, Security, API keys and select Create key. Copy the key at once; it is shown only one time. Send it in the X-API-Key header. Each key is limited to 120 requests per minute.

articles.title: Export reports to CSV
articles.body: Any report in Valam.ai can be exported. Open the report, choose Export and pick CSV or Excel. Large exports are emailed when they are ready.

articles.title: Check service status
articles.body: The status page shows whether each product is operational, degraded or down, with current incidents and maintenance windows.

articles.title: Forgot your password
articles.body: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email address. Follow the link in the email to choose a new password. The link expires after one hour.

articles.title: Change your time zone and date format
articles.body: Open Preferences, then Language and formats. Choose your time zone, date format and time format. Dates across the platform use your choice.

articles.title: Request a refund
articles.body: Refunds are issued by platform administrators. Contact support with the invoice number. A full or partial refund goes back to the original payment method.

articles.title: Cómo pagar una factura
articles.body: Abre Facturación, elige la factura y selecciona Pagar ahora. Puedes pagar con tarjeta o UPI. Cuando el pago se confirma, recibes el recibo por correo electrónico.

articles.title: Olvidé mi contraseña
articles.body: En la página de inicio de sesión selecciona Olvidé mi contraseña y escribe tu correo electrónico. Sigue el enlace del correo para elegir una contraseña nueva.

articles.title: Renovación automática de la suscripción
articles.body: Las suscripciones se renuevan automáticamente al final de cada periodo. Te enviamos recordatorios antes de la fecha de renovación.

articles.title: Añadir miembros a la organización
articles.body: Los administradores de la organización añaden personas desde la página Miembros. Cada miembro activo usa una licencia.

articles.title: Configurar el inicio de sesión único
articles.body: Conecta tu proveedor de identidad con SAML u OIDC para que los empleados inicien sesión con la cuenta de la empresa.

articles.title: Exportar informes
articles.body: Cualquier informe se puede exportar a CSV o Excel. Las exportaciones grandes se envían por correo cuando están listas.

articles.title: Cambiar la zona horaria
articles.body: Abre Preferencias y luego Idioma y formatos. Elige tu zona horaria y el formato de fecha y hora.

articles.title: Solicitar un reembolso
articles.body: Los reembolsos los emiten los administradores de la plataforma. Escribe a soporte con el número de factura.

articles.title: Estado del servicio
articles.body: La página de estado muestra si cada producto funciona con normalidad, con degradación o está caído, y las incidencias actuales.

articles.title: Crear una clave de API
articles.body: Ve a Cuenta, Seguridad, Claves de API y selecciona Crear clave. Copia la clave al momento: solo se muestra una vez.
